t: The Collingwood H2 Lite Select is a fixed, fire-rated LED downlight designed for efficient illumination. Ideal for electricians installing in high-moisture areas like kitchens and bathrooms. This mains-powered 5W unit features an integrated LED with a selectable colour temperature switch offering 2700K, 3000K and 4000K. The fire rating of 30, 60, and 90 minutes ensures safety compliance, whilst the IP65 rating provides robust protection. Delivering up to 650 lumens, this dimmable matt white downlight offers flexible, long-lasting performance with a 50,000 hour lifespan. The downlight includes a two-part connector and push-in terminal block with LENNEL wiring configuration for quick installation.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
